label: b2-binding-1
text:
Node binding-1 (2 of 2): make the agent's Claude Code run the checks of R7 (/opt/enforce/checks/R7) at PostToolUse on Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Bash, in /workspace/.claude/settings.json: the project's settings, which load for the agent in /workspace and not for your own session; hooks that other rules' bindings already put there stay. The hook reads the files just written, on disk (after a shell command: the files it changed); it runs every check on every file it reads (or on the reply) and reports all their violations in one message; on a violation it should exit 2 with the check's message, which the agent sees at once. Block only the violation, so the agent can fix its work and go on.
Done when: `/opt/enforce-harness/try --check` reports nothing, and each test case of R7, given to the hooks as the agent would make it (written by a file tool and by a shell command, or sent as the reply), is blocked with a message naming its rule when it breaks the rule, and passes when it follows it. The harness checks this when you reply.
